summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Romanian delivery platform prototype FAZA 1. All core features working correctly including login system, admin dashboard with map and order management, driver PWA app with status progression, and order assignment workflow.
passed_tests: Login page loads with Demo Admin and Demo Driver buttons
Manual login works for admin (admin@delivery.ro / admin123)
Manual login works for driver (driver-001@delivery.ro / driver123)
Invalid login shows proper error message
Admin login redirects to /admin dashboard
Driver login redirects to /driver app
Admin dashboard shows map with driver markers (green=active, blue=inactive)
Admin dashboard shows orders table with Romanian status badges
Admin can assign orders to drivers using assign dialog
Driver app shows assigned order with all details (name, phone, address, amount, payment type)
Driver SUNĂ (call) button opens tel: link correctly
Driver Accept button changes status to ACCEPTED
Driver AM RIDICAT COMANDA button changes status to PICKED_UP
Driver AM LIVRAT button changes status to DELIVERED
After delivery completion, driver sees NICIO COMANDĂ (no-order) state
API /api/seed endpoint creates demo data successfully
API /api/auth/login works for both admin and driver
API /api/orders returns orders list with proper data
API /api/drivers returns drivers list with locations
API order assignment functionality works correctly
API order status update functionality works correctly
Real-time data refresh works (10s intervals for admin, 5s for driver)
Logout functionality works properly for both roles
